summary: Versions 0.19.0 and 0.19.1 are live (release efcf0df1094b, CI and CodeQL green, 50 stocks, session prices for DOL and FTS). On /portfolio the REAL section has an 'At the broker' table: for each real position the stop market price, the target alert and an optional near-stop alert, the owner's level marked YOURS with the plan's beside it; a form changes them, a typo is refused with its reason. The session panel uses the owner's levels. The scanner marks held stocks (HELD, real shares and price); a buy on a held stock reads as a position to manage. 0.19.1 fixes the REAL table, which showed Friday's close as 'last' on Monday: it now uses the session price with its time, or names the close. A build during the session froze the 256 MB machine for about fifteen minutes; the release went out with the service paused for the build.

decisions: Confirmed: a form to enter the levels placed at the broker; held positions shown on the scanner and the orders (owner, 2026-11-23); release approved after screenshots ('oui go').

Proposed, built as proposed: levels in their own file; refusals (not a price, more than half the last close away, stop below near-stop alert below target alert); the owner's near-stop alert replaces half an ATR (D-055).
Owner, 2026-11-23: deploy during the session with a few minutes of downtime ('oui pas de prob. go').
